newsitem.title: UK: CDL Hotels favourite to buy Radisson-paper.
newsitem.headline: CDL Hotels favourite to buy Radisson-paper.

text.p: CDL Hotels International Ltd, the hotel arm of Singapore's City Developments Ltd, is tipped to become the buyer of the Radisson SAS Hotels Worldwide, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.
Radisson SAS Hotels Worldwide is a subsidiary of Scandinavian Airline Systems (SAS) and includes about 80 hotels in 23 countries.
Radisson SAS, however, actually owns or leases only seven hotels. The rest are operated under management contracts, the Sunday Telegraph said.
SAS discreetly put its Radisson hotel operations on the market a month ago, the paper added.
After two bidding rounds the only potential buyers left are understood to be CDL Hotels, one other, unnamed trade buyer and one unidentified financial group, the Sunday Telegraph said.
